firstGeneration.description: Native pixel dog idle animation, south facing in every frame including final hold; 40x40 transparent canvas, entire canvas used, >=2px clear at every edge. Same native dog size, crisp palette, eyes, coat, fixed camera, no props or text. Every frame: fixed unchanged head silhouette, outline, tail, coat markings and paws; preserve seed tail shape and position; chest breathing <=1px; blinking optional; changes limited to approved subtle breathing or blinking, with no new or moving appendages and consistent idle appendage/tail carriage. No wag cycle, bob, unexplained appendage, crown, antenna or tail above ears. If tail hidden, keep it hidden and never add one above the head; hidden front tail remains behind body; side/rear tails remain complete and connected in approved pose. All paws and tail complete; preserve native pixel size; no cropping, shrinking, blur or detached parts. Loop smoothly to initial pose.
